content: Orot Jever Asi Komasin
On an rai sabu ibosuruf irarat tafanam au engon ibonu ato nanatus jeverig mat sirat.
Osi God nanatun orot sabu tafanamai nanatus jeverig sites on momogis fafa on mes asi gogoi nanaba siboes siawanis.
Namon BADA iyau, “Yau au yabat aratein ato sabu abites on men arimon sinama au wantoan mes, yabin osi on sabu maiauis. Osi on men sinama inan kwanda 120 ini sobonai mes.”
On an werai a wera gibunai sabu on gagamis kokoiis bag simama. Osi on God nanatun orot ato tafanamai sabu nanatus jeverig sibi awanis on nanatus sirat sabu faiwaris a wabis gagamis bag ainau simama.
Ato BADA it sabu tafanamai simama asi yawas on komasis bag, mat osi sabu asi bainonot ra fufur sibi nonot on engon komasis wat.
Ato BADA inonotai on iyobin sabu tafanamai on men it ifouris on mes nunuan on ibaban kwakwan.

On mes BADA iyau, “Basit Yau sabu tafanamai afofouris on engon ani komasis a an fufun insawar, bobaitu, kiwiu a motob tefanai sawar yayawasis bai yayobis on mat engon ani komasis, yabin abi yababan on aibo mes nanaba afouris.”
Baise BADA on Noah aurin iyasisir.
Noah
Atonio on Noah an dudur. On nanatun orot engon ton: Shem, Ham a Japheth. Noah an yawas on totorin wat, on tafanamai sabu sanasi imama on an ubar tani ambin. On God ituranai rus kaitanei wat sibibib.
Baise God matanai sabu tafanamai simama asi yawas sifofour on engon komasin wat. Tafanam au engon on bai gagam a yawasis komsis wat on ibonu.
God iyeit tafanam au engon it on komasin bag, yabin sabu engon tutufin on yawas komasis wat sifofour simama.
On mes God on Noah iyawur iyau, “Yau ai nonot nono sabu engon tutufin an fufun insawar, yabin tafanam amonai on gamo a bai gagam wat on awan ibonu. Yau on dura bag tafanam a sabu engon ani komasis.
On mes om wengar obin tani unboai ato on nan am wa unyon, ato amonai efan engon un botitiwag, weie amonai a kounai on fotu rababarinai wat on un bobabaren.
Om wa un yoyonin an weroromin on 130 mita, ato wa an tayabarin on 22 mita, ato wa amon emon igai au uwayob on 13 mita.

Om wa tefan an guwi un yoyonin on men un iyamai insur kwakwan wa rewan engon in yafotai mes. Ab om 5 mita nanaba on masar uni kirir ato ratafin inar. Ato wa amonai ma an efan on engon ton uniyamen, tani on babanai, tani on basunai a tani on tefanai ato metewan on kaitamom sesebinai un yein.
Yau arimon sareu gagamin ani yafarai tafanam au engon in boai ato sawar yayawasis semama on engon ini komasis. Ato sawar engon tutufin tafanamai semama on engon sinarab.
Ato baise yau arimon rut dura bo baibasit tani yamai weie om awam rum a nanatum orot awawas mat on wonan wa amonai wonar.
Om on bobaitu a sawar yayawasis ruruam ruruam, orot a jever on un boes mat wa amonai wonar ato un kaifares yawasis sinama.

Mat om kiwiu asi dam ta ta on ruruam ruruam, orot a jever a bobaitu gagamis a gugudis asi dam ta ta a sawar bai yayobis asi dam ta ta motobai sekakayam on mat engon un boes wa amonai wonar un kaifares yawasis sinama.
Om on bayu magis ta ta menan aam aurin on engon unabo ato nan efan kaita unyadodog, fani om aurim a fani osi mat auris.”
God mamaba Noah i forai on engon nanaba ifour.
